title: LLMs Improving LLMs: Agentic Discovery for Test-Time Scaling
authors_zh: Tong Zheng、Haolin Liu、Chengsong Huang、Huiwen Bao、Sheng Zhang、Rui Liu、Runpeng Dai、Ruibo Chen、Chenxi Liu、Tianyi Xiong、Xidong Wu、Hongming Zhang、Heng Huang（机构：马里兰大学、弗吉尼亚大学、圣路易斯华盛顿大学、北卡罗来纳大学、Google、Meta）
paper_type_zh: 智能体式测试时扩展控制器发现研究
best_for_zh: 正在开发自适应多轨迹推理系统，并希望以可重复方式搜索计算分配策略而非手调启发式规则的读者。
one_line: AutoTTS discovers test-time branching and stopping controllers in an offline replay environment, improving the accuracy-token frontier without hand-coding a fixed scaling rule.
AutoTTS 在离线回放环境中发现测试时的分支与停止控制器，无需手工编写固定扩展规则即可改善准确率—词元前沿。
why: It makes the allocation policy itself searchable and exposes an inexpensive offline route for comparing branch, probe, pruning, and stopping decisions.
inclusion_reason: It automates width-depth inference-budget allocation by discovering when to branch, continue, probe, prune, or stop reasoning trajectories and evaluates the resulting accuracy-cost scaling curve.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Test-time scaling methods commonly commit to a hand-written schedule: sample a fixed number of branches, stop after a threshold, or apply a manually chosen pruning rule. Such decisions determine whether inference tokens are spent exploring alternatives, extending a promising thought, querying a probe, or terminating. Because these controls interact, adjusting a few thresholds by intuition explores only a small and potentially unrepresentative part of the available accuracy-cost trade-off.

The paper asks how to discover an allocation policy rather than hand-design one. The desired policy must make fine-grained decisions over a multi-trajectory reasoning process while remaining affordable to evaluate repeatedly. Directly running a base model for every proposed controller would be prohibitively expensive, and a scalar score alone does not tell a search agent why a candidate overspent tokens or discarded useful branches. The problem is therefore both an inference-control problem and a low-cost strategy-search problem.

测试时扩展方法通常预先承诺一种手写日程：采样固定数量的分支、在阈值后停止，或应用人工选定的剪枝规则。这些决定规定推理词元究竟用于探索替代方案、延长有希望的思路、查询探针，还是结束推理。由于这些控制相互作用，仅凭直觉调整少数阈值只能探索可用准确率—成本权衡中很小且可能没有代表性的一部分。

论文研究如何发现计算分配策略，而不是手工设计策略。理想策略既要能对多轨迹推理过程作出细粒度决定，又必须能被反复、低成本地评估。若对每个候选控制器都直接运行基础模型，成本会高得难以承受；而单一分数也无法告诉搜索智能体某候选为何浪费词元或丢弃有价值的分支。因此，这既是推理控制问题，也是低成本策略搜索问题。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
AutoTTS changes the object that a researcher designs. Instead of prescribing a particular test-time heuristic, the researcher specifies a discovery environment with states, actions, feedback, and an objective; an explorer then writes controller code inside that environment. In the width-depth instantiation, a controller sees active branches, their current depths, revealed probe answers, and remaining budget, then decides whether to branch, continue, probe, prune, or answer.

The key enabler is offline replay. The base model's candidate trajectories and intermediate probe signals are collected once, so a proposed controller can replay its decisions against a fixed matrix rather than calling the model again. Beta parameterization forces each controller to expose one monotone budget knob, while execution traces reveal how computation was allocated. Together, these choices make strategy discovery a controllable search over the accuracy-token frontier rather than a collection of incomparable manually tuned rules.

AutoTTS 改变了研究者需要设计的对象。研究者不再规定某个具体的测试时启发式规则，而是定义一个包含状态、动作、反馈和目标的发现环境；探索器随后在该环境中编写控制器代码。在宽度—深度实例中，控制器观察活跃分支、当前深度、已揭示的探针答案和剩余预算，然后决定分支、继续、探测、剪枝还是作答。

核心条件是离线回放。基础模型的候选轨迹和中间探针信号只收集一次，因此候选控制器能在固定矩阵上回放决策，而不必再次调用模型。贝塔参数化要求每个控制器只暴露一个单调的预算旋钮，执行轨迹则显示计算如何被分配。这些设计共同把策略发现变成对准确率—词元前沿的可控搜索，而不是一组无法比较、靠手工调节的规则。

title: Method
方法
html:
For every question, the method pre-collects 128 independent reasoning trajectories from a base model, segmented into 500-token intervals, together with intermediate answer probes. A controller's state contains the question, instantiated and active branches, prefixes, depths, revealed probes, and remaining budget. Its atomic actions are BRANCH, CONTINUE, PROBE, PRUNE, and ANSWER. A terminal aggregation rule turns the state into an answer, and the objective rewards exact accuracy while penalizing generation and probe cost.

The authors use AIME24 as the discovery set and hold out AIME25 and HMMT25. Claude Code proposes controller implementations over five rounds after reading prior code, accuracy-token curves, and execution histories. Each candidate is evaluated 64 times on random subsets of the stored trajectories. The final controller is compared with SC@64, adaptive and early self-consistency, and Parallel-Probe across Qwen3 models from 0.6B to 8B, then tested on a distilled Llama model and GPQA Diamond to assess transfer beyond the search setting.

对每个问题，方法从基础模型预先收集 128 条独立推理轨迹，并以 500 词元为间隔切分，同时收集中间答案探针。控制器状态包含问题、已实例化且活跃的分支、前缀、深度、已揭示探针和剩余预算。其原子动作是 BRANCH、CONTINUE、PROBE、PRUNE 和 ANSWER。终止聚合规则把状态转成答案，目标函数奖励精确准确率，同时惩罚生成和探针成本。

作者使用 AIME24 作为发现集，并保留 AIME25 和 HMMT25 用于测试。Claude Code 在五轮中阅读先前代码、准确率—词元曲线和执行历史后提出控制器实现。每个候选都在存储轨迹的随机子集上重复评估 64 次。最终控制器与 SC@64、自适应及早停自一致性、Parallel-Probe 比较，覆盖 0.6B 到 8B 的 Qwen3 模型；随后又在蒸馏 Llama 模型和 GPQA Diamond 上测试，以检验能否超越搜索设置迁移。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
On held-out AIME25 and HMMT25, the discovered controllers generally form a stronger accuracy-token frontier than the hand-crafted baselines. Averaged over the four main Qwen3 sizes, the beta 0.5 controller uses about 69.5% fewer tokens than SC@64 while keeping essentially equal average accuracy, 45.3 versus 45.2. With beta 1.0, it exceeds the peak accuracy of all hand-crafted baselines in five of the eight reported model-benchmark settings, showing that the controller is not merely a fixed-cost compression rule.

The transfer tests give more specific support for the allocation claim. On DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B with HMMT25, beta 1 reaches 27.2 accuracy with 533.9K tokens, compared with SC@64's 26.7 and 985.7K; on Qwen3-1.7B with GPQA Diamond it reaches 41.6 with 270.1K tokens, compared with 41.3 and 510.0K. The paper also reports a total discovery cost of 39.9 US dollars and 160 minutes, which is evidence that replay makes policy search operationally cheaper than repeated online experimentation.

在保留的 AIME25 和 HMMT25 上，发现出的控制器总体形成了比手工基线更强的准确率—词元前沿。对四种主要 Qwen3 尺寸取平均，贝塔为 0.5 的控制器比 SC@64 少用约 69.5% 的词元，同时保持几乎相同的平均准确率，即 45.3 对 45.2。贝塔为 1.0 时，它在报告的八个模型—基准设置中有五个超过所有手工基线的峰值准确率，说明该控制器并非只是固定成本的压缩规则。

迁移测试更具体地支持了计算分配主张。在 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B 的 HMMT25 上，贝塔为 1 达到 27.2 的准确率和 533.9K 词元，而 SC@64 为 26.7 和 985.7K；在 Qwen3-1.7B 的 GPQA Diamond 上，前者达到 41.6 和 270.1K，后者为 41.3 和 510.0K。论文还报告发现过程总成本为 39.9 美元和 160 分钟，这表明回放能让策略搜索在实际操作中比反复在线试验更便宜。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The new element is the environment-driven discovery formulation. Existing adaptive methods may branch, prune, or stop intelligently, but their policy family and thresholds are chosen before evaluation. AutoTTS treats those choices as controller code to be searched, and deliberately separates expensive generation from cheap controller evaluation. This lets an LLM reason over failures in previous scaling curves and alter the policy, rather than only tune a numeric threshold inside one fixed algorithm.

The one-dimensional beta requirement is also a substantive design decision. Without it, a code-generating explorer tends to introduce many sharp, search-set-specific knobs that make a reported curve hard to reproduce and likely to overfit. The method does not claim a universal optimum over all tree-search policies, nor does it invent the underlying actions. Its contribution is a reusable discovery scaffold that jointly exposes the actions, feedback, budget constraint, and behavioral history needed to search their composition.

新的部分是环境驱动的发现表述。既有自适应方法也许会智能地分支、剪枝或停止，但其策略族和阈值在评测前就已选定。AutoTTS 把这些选择视为待搜索的控制器代码，并刻意把昂贵的生成与廉价的控制器评估分离。这使大语言模型能够根据先前扩展曲线中的失败进行推理并改变策略，而不只是对固定算法中的一个数值阈值调参。

一维贝塔约束同样是实质性的设计决定。没有它，代码生成探索器往往引入许多陡峭、只适配搜索集的旋钮，使报告的曲线难以复现且容易过拟合。该方法并未宣称在所有树搜索策略中找到普遍最优，也没有发明底层动作。它的贡献是一个可复用的发现支架，联合显露出搜索这些动作组合所需的动作、反馈、预算约束和行为历史。

title: Limitations
局限
html: Offline replay assumes that pre-collected branches and probes adequately represent the trajectories an online controller would encounter; a controller cannot recover an unseen branch or react to live tool observations. The search is demonstrated mainly on exact-answer mathematical reasoning, and its use of Claude Code, fixed interval length, fixed probe protocol, and a five-round budget leaves several design choices unexplored. Better replay performance also does not prove that a policy will preserve latency, memory, or calibration properties in a live production system.
离线回放假设预先收集的分支和探针能充分代表在线控制器会遇到的轨迹；控制器无法找回未见分支，也不能对实时工具观察作出反应。搜索主要在精确答案的数学推理上展示，并且使用 Claude Code、固定间隔长度、固定探针协议和五轮预算，仍有许多设计选择尚未探索。更好的回放表现也不能证明某个策略会在真实生产系统中保持延迟、内存或校准性质。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use this work when a team has several plausible test-time controls but cannot afford a full online ablation for every policy. Build a replay table with enough trajectory diversity, define a small action space and a cost-aware terminal objective, and retain execution histories rather than only aggregate scores. Before deployment, revalidate the selected controller online, especially if tool outputs, user requests, or model versions differ from the replay distribution.
当团队拥有多种可信的测试时控制方案，却无法为每种策略承担完整在线消融成本时，可以使用这项工作。应构建具有足够轨迹多样性的回放表，定义较小的动作空间和考虑成本的终止目标，并保留执行历史而非只保留聚合分数。部署前仍须在线复验选中的控制器，尤其在工具输出、用户请求或模型版本与回放分布不同时。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: The essential comparison is a full accuracy-token curve, not one point at a chosen beta. Read the held-out AIME25 and HMMT25 rows separately from AIME24 because only the former support generalization beyond the discovery environment. Also distinguish controller-discovery cost from inference cost: the reported 39.9-dollar discovery expense is a one-time search cost, whereas the tokens in the tables are the cost paid each time a problem is solved.
最关键的比较是一整条准确率—词元曲线，而不是某个选定贝塔下的单一点。应把保留的 AIME25 和 HMMT25 行与 AIME24 分开阅读，因为只有前者支持超越发现环境的泛化结论。还应区分控制器发现成本和推理成本：报告的 39.9 美元发现费用是一次性搜索成本，而表中词元则是每次解决问题都需支付的成本。
